diff --git a/taskcluster/docs/loading.rst b/taskcluster/docs/loading.rst
index b902b0dcf05..e4066c524c0 100644
--- a/taskcluster/docs/loading.rst
+++ b/taskcluster/docs/loading.rst
@@ -29,12 +29,12 @@ style pattern matching via `pathspec`.
 
 .. code-block:: yaml
   reference-tasks:
-    - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-19
+    - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-18
     - linux64-cargo-vet
     - linux64-cbindgen

 **or use wildcards**

     attributes:
         local-toolchain: true
     treeherder:
-        symbol: TL(clang-19)

     worker-type: b-linux-gcp
     worker:
         max-run-time: 600

     attributes:
         local-toolchain: true
     treeherder:
-        symbol: TW64(clang-19)
+        symbol: TW64(clang-18)
     worker-type: b-linux-gcp
     worker:
         max-run-time: 600
@@ -70,13 +70,13 @@ win64-clang-19:
